endorsements.quote: Regular auditing of model performance across groups is essential, particularly as clinical environments and patient populations evolve.
Developers should explicitly specify choices of metrics and selection strategies and disclose how these decisions might impact disparities.
Patients and community members could serve in advisory roles to help ensure that decisions surrounding model development and deployment align with community priorities.

unlisted_practices: Governments and hospitals should ensure that models are scrutinized with transparent fairness guidelines before and throughout deployment.
Regulators should incorporate explicit fairness requirements into the FDA approval process for Software as a Medical Device.
Develop scenario-specific guidelines setting the maximum degree to which a diagnostic algorithm may violate fairness criteria such as equalized odds to determine when models are unfit for deployment.
Integrate ethical frameworks into the evaluation of clinical machine-learning systems at the initial stages of model design.
Establish additional mechanisms to assess AI fairness after deployment beyond regulatory approval.

screen.reason: This is a commentary discussing algorithmic fairness in oncology AI and outlining governance and deployment priorities such as post-deployment auditing and regulatory oversight.
